name: Sentaro
summary: Email threat detection that flags phishing, risky and malicious messages right in your inbox. It surfaces the dangerous emails that look perfectly normal, before anyone clicks.
best_for: SMBs on Google Workspace/M365 that want an extra AI layer against phishing and BEC without infrastructure changes
skip_if: you already run a mature email-security stack (Ironscales/Abnormal-class), or nobody internally will review the flagged-mail queue
honest_knock: The category claim (AI catches what filters miss) is plausible, Microsoft/Google native filtering misses sophisticated BEC, but any vendor's accuracy percentage is measured on their own test set, not your mail flow. The honest procurement move: run their trial alongside your current filtering, count real catches and false positives for two weeks, and price per mailbox against the incumbents with that data in hand.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month per protected account (first account free)
pricing.notes: (read 27 November 2026 on sentaro.com/en/pricing) Priced per user, in USD: 'Prices in USD, per user.' Pro is $6 per user per month after the first, and the first account stays free. The page no longer shows an annual price; on 24 September 2026 it offered $68 per account per year. A Free single-user tier (one account, private or company-attached, no card, no expiry) is listed but marked 'coming soon'. Sovereign is custom annual pricing: dedicated EU tenancy, custom DPA and audit support, SIEM export and API access, and a named security engineer. A user is one mailbox Sentaro watches; shared aliases and distribution lists do not count. Pro lists cross-vector chain response (block and quarantine, with forced re-auth and session revocation marked 'coming soon'), the admin console, audit trail and reporting, and cancel anytime. The Identity and Behavioral vectors are marked 'coming soon' and, per the page, will be included in every plan at no added cost. Monthly plans stop at the end of the period; Sovereign agreements follow the refund policy, and purchases through Paddle carry a full refund within 14 days, renewals included. History: no price was published until August 2026. On 5 September the site showed Professional at $6 monthly or $5.50 annual, with the same numerals offered in euros, and SSO/SCIM, API access and compliance support on a quote-only Enterprise tier. On 24 September Pro was $6 a month or $68 a year per protected account, the page said every feature was in every plan, and it gave Q4 2026 for the Identity and Behavioral vectors; on 27 November the annual price and the Q4 date were gone and forced re-auth and session revocation were marked 'coming soon'.
